---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for LocTT
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Which surface would this affect?**
CLI / MCP / Web UI / core data model / more than one

**What problem does this solve?**
Describe the situation you run into today, and why the current behaviour
falls short — not just the feature you want, but the need behind it.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear description of what you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any other approaches or workarounds you've tried or thought about.

**Additional context**
Anything else — mockups, links to similar features in other tools,
related issues, etc.

Note: LocTT is deliberately scoped as a local-first, single-user tool
(see `docs/dev/decisions.md` for things decided against). A feature
request that reintroduces multi-user auth, hosted sync, or a database
backend is likely out of scope — check the decisions doc first if in
doubt.
